description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.drift parity (DriftTracker state and flush modes before finding fingerprint).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-drift-finding-fingerprint: into_findings on a non-empty transition buffer calls make_finding, which needs sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes. Rust stops at the missing fingerprint codec and does not return Finding objects. The harness drives DriftTracker and checks only empty_ok versus that codec error. Pin snapshots of version_baseline, seen, and transition rows stay in the vector and are not asserted, because those fields are private.
